newsitem.title: USA: U.S. reserve assets fell $1.69 bln in July.
newsitem.headline: U.S. reserve assets fell $1.69 bln in July.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Friday that U.S. reserve assets fell $1.69 billion in July to $66.12 billion from $67.81 billion in June.
The department said U.S. holdings of foreign currencies declined to $31.58 billion from $32.94 billion in June.
Gold stock totaled $11.05 billion in both months.
Special Drawing Rights with the International Monetary Fund fell to $9.81 billion in July from $10.02 billion.
The value of the U.S. reserve position with the IMF decreased to $13.68 billion in July from $13.81 billion in June.
